key.name: opacity
key.description: Opacity of the matched panel background color, in percent.

key.name: maximized-opacity
key.summary: Panel background opacity with maximized windows
key.description: Opacity of the panel background, in percent, while a maximized or fullscreen window is on the primary monitor.

key.name: gradient
key.description: Fade the panel background vertically from the opacity at the top edge to the gradient bottom opacity at the bottom edge, letting a blur behind the panel show through. A maximized or fullscreen window on the primary monitor turns it off.

key.name: gradient-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the panel background at its bottom edge, in percent, while the gradient is on.

key.name: gradient-intensity
key.description: How strongly the Blur my Shell panel blur is deepened toward the top edge while the gradient is on, in percent of the default. 0 leaves the blur in its own colors, as its own pipeline draws them; above 100 deepens it further. The brightness compensation adds to it in the same proportion.

key.name: gradient-softness
key.description: How softly the Blur my Shell panel blur fades out toward the bottom edge while the gradient is on, in percent. 0 fades it linearly, which stops changing abruptly at the bottom edge and shows there as a line; 100 eases the fade out so it levels off into the backdrop.

key.name: brightness-compensation
key.description: How strongly the panel color is darkened, bright colors more and dark ones barely, so the white text stands out over a backdrop close to its brightness, with its saturation boosted slightly to keep it vivid, in percent. A translucent panel darkens its color further for the same effect. With the gradient on, the Blur my Shell panel blur is always deepened toward the top edge, pixel by pixel in its own colors, and this deepens it further. 0 disables it.

key.name: text-contrast
key.description: How strongly bright colors are darkened to keep the white panel text readable, in percent. 0 disables it; 100 aims for 4.5:1 contrast. The panel always stays a vivid shade of the backdrop, never darker than a third of it, so a very bright backdrop behind a translucent panel leaves the rest to the text shadow.

key.name: saturation-boost
key.description: How much more saturated the panel color gets than the sampled backdrop, the darker the panel the more, in percent of the default boost. 0 keeps the backdrop's own hue; 100 is the default; above it pushes further toward a vivid, saturated shade.

key.name: invert-text
key.description: Instead of darkening a color too bright for the white panel text, keep it and turn the text and symbolic icons black whenever black reads better. The text contrast strength sets how much white is preferred: at 100 the color with more contrast wins, at 50 black needs twice the contrast of white, and at 0 the text never turns dark.

key.name: text-shadow
key.description: Cast a soft, neutral dark shadow from the panel text and icons onto what's behind them, like macOS's transparent menu bar, stronger the less contrast the text has. Dark text gets none.

key.name: maximized-shadow
key.description: Keep the text shadow while a maximized or fullscreen window is on the primary monitor. When off, the shadow is hidden only while such a window is there, and comes back as soon as none is.

key.name: shadow-distance
key.description: How far down the text shadow is cast, in pixels.

key.name: shadow-radius
key.description: How far out from the text and icons the shadow fades, in pixels. 0 gives a sharp shadow.

key.name: shadow-opacity
key.description: How dark the text shadow is right next to the text, in percent, where the text has the least contrast. Where it has plenty, the shadow keeps 70 % of it.

key.name: shadow-vibrance
key.description: How much the text shadow takes on a deeper, more saturated tone of the backdrop's own hue instead of a neutral dark, in percent: 0 is neutral, like macOS, and 100 fully saturated, e.g. navy on a blue sky.

key.name: wallpaper-accent
key.description: Set the system accent color to the one closest to the wallpaper's most prominent hue.

key.name: saved-accent
key.description: The user's own accent color, restored when the wallpaper accent is turned off. Empty when nothing is saved.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log sampled colors and overview events to the journal.
